user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT search features
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled to surface answers and links in ChatGPT search
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety of web pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT
user_agents.scope: Only visits landing pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content to train OpenAI generative AI foundation models
user_agents.scope: Web content used for training generative AI foundation models
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Execute user-initiated actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs
user_agents.scope: Web pages visited when users ask questions or use GPT Actions
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply to user-initiated actions

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to enhance AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Public web content potentially contributing to generative AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow ClaudeBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Retrieves web content to answer individual user queries in Claude.
user_agents.scope: Websites accessed through user-initiated requests in Claude.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Claude-User in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates web content to improve search result relevance and accuracy.
user_agents.scope: Online content analyzed specifically to optimize search results for users.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Claude-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Finds information for building Google search indexes and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under User-agent Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawls images, logos, and favicons for Google products.
user_agents.scope: Affects Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and image features in Search.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under User-agent Googlebot-Image.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Crawls video content for video-related search features.
user_agents.scope: Affects video-related Google Search features and products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under User-agent Googlebot-Video.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for Google News surfaces.
user_agents.scope: Affects the Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under User-agent Googlebot-News.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for Google Shopping features.
user_agents.scope: Affects all surfaces of Google Shopping.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under User-agent Storebot-Google.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Crawls pages for Search testing and inspection tools.
user_agents.scope: Affects testing tools like Rich Result Test and URL inspection in Search Console.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under User-agent Google-InspectionTool.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawler for product teams and internal research and development.
user_agents.scope: Does not affect specific products; used for general fetching of public content.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under User-agent GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible image URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Optimized version of GoogleOther for public image URLs without affecting specific products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under User-agent GoogleOther-Image.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible video URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Optimized version of GoogleOther for public video URLs without affecting specific products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under User-agent GoogleOther-Video.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls sites requested by owners for Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Affects crawls requested by site owners for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under User-agent Google-CloudVertexBot.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of crawled site content for Gemini training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Affects Gemini model training and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under User-agent Google-Extended.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects and indexes web data automatically for search.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Fetches web data in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features across Spotlight, Siri, Safari, and Apple ecosystem.
user_agents.scope: Web content used for Apple search products and generative AI features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls content usage for training Apple generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Generative AI training data across Apple Intelligence, Services, and Developer Tools.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content of apps or websites shared across Meta apps.
user_agents.scope: App or website content shared on Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt, but may bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality.
user_agents.scope: Web content analyzed to enhance relevance and accuracy of Meta AI responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to improve advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Web content for business and advertising products.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Trains foundation AI models and improves products by indexing content.
user_agents.scope: Web content indexed directly for foundation AI models and products.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and supports agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Individual links requested by users and websites navigated to complete user tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt because it performs user-requested fetches.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves Amazon products and services and may train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Web crawling for product improvements and Amazon AI model training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt or use noarchive and noindex meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services such as Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Search indexing for Amazon products and services without generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt or use noindex meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions by fetching live information for Alexa queries.
user_agents.scope: Live web retrieval initiated by user actions to answer queries.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives due to user initiation.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Builds open web crawl datasets for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Automated web crawler fetching publicly accessible web pages across domain names.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow rules for User-agent CCBot in robots.txt or use opt-out registry.
